title: For CLI-only UI passes, the brief should say that renders come from a go test -overlay file in the role's tmp dir, and the role allowlist should permit `go test -overlay` and a leading ENV= prefix

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-035228-7421, project ork, item S403:

For CLI-only UI passes, the brief should say that renders come from a go test -overlay file in the role's tmp dir, and the role allowlist should permit `go test -overlay` and a leading ENV= prefix

Evidence: the RENDER_DIR=... go test prefix and an awk width check were denied as "contains multiple operations"; the overlay with a hardcoded path worked.
